jcr:title: Advanced Digital Healthcare
jcr:description: From advanced devices and software that transform care settings into state-of-the-art environments, to advanced visualization that guides surgeons and robotics with insightful analytics, Stryker’s Advanced Digital Healthcare is driving improved clinical, operational and financial outcomes across the continuum of care.

largeheadline.line1:
Advanced
Digital Healthcare

When Dr. Homer Stryker, an orthopaedic surgeon from Kalamazoo, Michigan, found that certain medical products were not meeting his patients’ needs, he invented new ones and pursued innovative ideas, guided by better patient outcomes. This desire to improve healthcare through innovation still drives us today.
Continuum of care
largeheadline.line2: From advanced devices and software that transform care settings into state-of-the-art environments, to advanced visualization that guides surgeons and SmartRobotics, Stryker’s Advanced Digital Healthcare is driving improved clinical, operational or financial outcomes across the continuum of care.

standaloneimage.alt: Stryker offers digital innovations in healthcare across the continuum of care

text.text: Stryker offers digital products and services across the continuum of care: event, transport, diagnose, plan, operate, recover, monitor, rehab and follow-up.

largeheadline_copy.line2: See how we are embracing digital capabilities to help enhance connectivity to make healthcare more precise, efficient or personalized.
